content: What you see is what you will get, if you are constantly looking for problems, that what will come around you. This is why God tells us to keep His Word ever before us, it is what will allow us to see victory even in the seemingly worst of situation. See with the eyes of the Word, see light in all things and watch the Light shine through.

The victory in life is already won, a Christian is not trying to get victory, he or she is not trying to get healing or prosperity, all things are already granted us in Christ; Jesus already conquered every force and circumstances on the Earth. Jesus after this great conquest handed us the victory. We are called to walk in the finished work of Christ. Victory is ours.

The word of God is unchangeable, Jesus sees you where you are, your false step doesn't change His Love for you. Nothing that you have done or has been done to you changes God's view of you. You are His Child, loved and pursued. Follow hard after His Love, don't waste time trying to correct what has been done, Enjoy what Jesus has already done for you.

Live life to the full, you are here to win, here to succeed and excel. Don't play 'not to lose', 'play to win'; there is a huge difference between the two, don't live not to be broke, live to be wealthy, don't live trying not to get sick, walk in Divine Health. Jesus didn't just get us out of Egypt, He has brought us into the promiseland. You are here to WIN.

There is no shortage of Ability in you, what you need is action, fear is the greatest enemy of your destiny. If you think you cannot achieve something, you have just made it impossible for yourself, if you believe you can you have opened the door to possibility, the size of the task doesn't matter, what matter is your belief and courage to pursue it. You are well able.

The Greatest call of life is to live for Jesus, your greatest fulfilment of life is to live for Him, to Bring glory to His name. All the gains of the Earth cannot satisfy, satisfaction is only in Jesus Christ, He is the only joy of the Human soul. Give Jesus your all, Serve Jesus with everything, that is what really matters.

This day is yet another opportunity to fulfil your God given Purpose, don't live any day without doing something that is attached to you and your destiny. Destiny is not just a destination you arrive at, it also has so much to do with the journey, every step is a destiny defining moment. Live out greatness today.

Live life with passion, don't be passive and let things pass you by, engage your purpose and the upward call of God for your life, run your race with endure and focus. We are here to make impact, we are here to stand up, we are here to shine our light and touch the lives of those that God bring across our path. Live for impact.

Jesus came to bring us life, religion is the creation of man, Life is only given by God, when you come to Jesus He opens the reality of Life apart from religion. There is nothing religious about the Son of God, dying on a cross to give all mankind life. Jesus came that we may have life, not to establish Christianity. He is a life giving spirit.

Don't love religious acts more than you love the Lord! A lot of people are so caught up in religion, that they miss the reality of what Christ has given us. A Christian is not one who does Christian things, he is one who has the Life of Christ in him. The Power of Christ in a man is what brings forth the nature of God. Christ is in you, the old nature is dead and Christ is now alive in you.

The biggest need of man is for relationship, it's a relationship with God that makes us belong and know that we valued and loved, God's love for us is what sets us apart from the world, He has called us to fellowship with Himself, there is no need to you to receive validation from any man, Jesus is all the validation you need. You are Loved by God and that is enough.

Whatever comes from the Heart has lasting impact, don't live life passionless. When God desired to save us, He gave us His Son from His heart, His only begotten Son, this is why salvation is so powerful. In whatever you do, do it heartily as unto the Lord! Greatness is born from passion.

The heights of Heaven are the filled with the Love of God, but so are the depth of the Earth, there is no place and no one who can escape His Love. God is Love, He knows everyone, He sees everyone, He is everywhere, yet He chooses to give Himself to everyone for their own benefit. Invite Love to do His perfect work in your life.

What would you give to achieve your dreams? Are you walking down the path of destiny? Your birth is your greatest opportunity for greatness, this Earth was designed to grow, multiply and bring forth the wonder of whatever is planted in it. The truth is living purposeless or living purposeful will both cost you the same thing; Your Life. Fulfill your purpose.

It's very important to know a destiny defining moment, there are decisions that will set a trajectory for your life, we must recognize them and choose to make informed decisions. You cannot run from them you cannot avoid them; who you are is shaped by them, in fact trying to avoid them is to make a decision all together. The Lord has given us His word, that we may never walk in darkness of the truth of God.

God made us for unity, to isolate oneself is to put yourself at a disadvantage in life. You cannot do life alone, you won't get far. That's why the design of God is for a child to be born into a family, and raised in a community, these interactions are what define who we are and what we become. Live with people, you were made to give and receive.

Heaven is available to you today, don't waste your time waiting to enjoy Heaven and all it is, when you leave this Earth. You are called to function there right now, you have a place to operate and receive from today. The truth is the Lord desires you to be a conduit of all the wonders and glory His kingdom here on Earth. Chose to experience Heavens reality now!

Love is permanent and eternal, it does not change or diminish. God Himself is Love, He is the revelation and reality of Love. Love has no past tense, there is no one that God loved and has stopped loving, His Love is eternal, you cannot out ran it, you cannot give Him reason enough to stop loving you. You are loved and pursued!

Jesus is the Light of the World. You don't have to walk in darkness over any area of your life. Let the Light shine through, embrace the reality of Christ as your light. You don't have to be uncertain about your future, the Lord is your light, His word makes the future clear, He makes us live life with hope and certainty.

The Gospel is powerful, it is not an idea to convince people about salvation through Jesus Christ: it is power wrapped up in words. God has packaged His power in the message of the Gospel that wherever it is declared it has the power the save, heal and deliver the recipient. There is nothing on Earth that can stop the Power of the Gospel, you have with you an unstoppable power, tell it everywhere you go.

Jesus is your light, you shall never walk in darkness, you are called to a higher life of Glory and wonder. If you would see the truth of having God in your life, you'll see that you life is an unending stream of wonders of His name. Truth is to be embraced and confessed, confession brings possession, speak the truth of the Word today.

The life we have in Christ is a life of freedom, this is a very important concept to understand for one to be fruitful in their walk with the Lord. We don't 'have' to serve God, rather we 'get' to serve Him. This is freedom, and freedom gives you privileges, it makes us masters of our choices and of the blessings that follow. Every who follows Christ does it by choice, not compulsion. The choice to be blessed is yours.

Look around you, are you pleased with what you see? Is the sight something you can live with forever or are you hoping for a drastic change? Jesus came that we may have an abundant and full life, anything short of that is changeable, and should be aligned with the Word! Live the Word life!

There is such a sweetness of being intimate with the Lord, it opens you up to divine reality of His glory. There are a lot of things God desires us to know and walk in but they are reserved those who will fellowship with Him. Just like you will be comfortable opening up only to those who pay genuine attention to you and are honest in their concern about your affairs. There is a whole new experience with God that awaits you.

Christianity is not a measure of how much one holds on to God, rather it is a revelation of how much God holds on to us. God loves us in spite of us, He loved us first and chose how He would relate to us before we ever made a decision to accept His salvation, He set the terms of Salvation, He is the one who makes it possible, He is the one holding us in Him.

Peace is a very precious commodity, it sets the basis of one's life and the speed at which they will progress, no matter what you own or what you are yet to acquire if one does not have peace, nothing they will possess will satisfy them. In Christ Jesus we have peace, it is the foundation upon which we live and serve God! We rise above even the most chaotic situation, because internally we have the peace. The Peace of God is in you.

If Jesus successfully took on human form that goes to show us that the desire of God is for us to totally be clothed in divinity. A denial of this is to refuse the purpose of God for mankind, Jesus didn't die and resurrect to make us peasant or slaves, He came to bring us up to His life, His Righteousness, and His Nature; The Father has raised us up together with Him.

Jesus came to give us rest, from the time Adam fell mankind has been toiling, everything he did stood to oppose him, this is why man's life on earth is characterized by toil and hard work, the statement is that the world only works when you work hard. God desires us to work, but we are called to work from rest not for it! Rest is the state of being in Christ, and walking in His finished work, Jesus is our Sabbath.

The Lord doesn't make His people slaves, He brings us into sonship, Jesus did not live, die and resurrect just so that you can barely get through life. He has made us Kings to reign on the Earth, what left is for us to know about it, we must walk in the Light of this truth by confession and awareness.

Grace is a celebration of God's boundless Love for us, manifested through the finished work of Jesus. We know that the God Loves us, and in His Love He has enabled us to be carriers of His divine nature and presence. Our very Salvation is testimony to the power of Grace!!

What a great Joy it is to be saved King David calls it the joy of salvation. Its an emotional exuberance that floods the soul and gives life vitality. This is what Grace has done for us, it is a celebration, the life we have in Christ, it is a celebration of Christ's conquest over satan and all circumstances of life, this is why the Apostle tells us to rejoice Always.. Thank God for His Grace.

This moment is an opportunity to do something that will take you a step closer to all that you desire to be, destiny is not just a destination; it is also the journey. Every passing second is a step into our future, are you fully equipped to possess the future that you have always desired? Do only those things with will give you advantage in the future that is before you.

Where people lose it is when they go to God with mindset of approaching a man. We can't relate with God in the basis of our relationships with men, God is spirit, His judgement system is spiritual, the spiritual laws are far above the natural, His ways are not the ways of man. The Word of God gives us the basis upon which we can relate with God! Be one who seeks out His ways and walk in the reality of His truth.

The ability to be succeed in life, is not totally based on your ability to work hard, there are so many people who work hard, yet are not even breaking even, Success in working in the Grace of God. It is finding rest in Christ and Functioning from the reality of the Finished work. Jesus has already made you a success in the world, and He has given us the victory and made us more than conquerors.

There is power that causes things to change in prayer. Worrying about things will not change them, hoping for change will not bring it into being, you have to rise up and bring your case before God, be direct and confront those things that you desire to change, God's power is available to you, and through prayer you tap into that power. Now is the time for your situation to turn around.

The faithfulness of God has nothing to do with yours. Faithful is who He is, Grace gives us access to God's faithfulness in spite of ourselves. God is and will always be faithful to you matter where you are or what you've done, that's the work of His divine Grace. He cannot deny Himself. You can only produces faithfulness in your life by acknowledging His work in you, and resting in His faithfulness.

The furthest one can go from God, is the place their minds and condemnation can take them, you are as far from God as you think you are, if you think you are not close to God, the truth is God does not share your options, There is no place that you can run from His Love, you are in the palm of His hand. Chose to side with the Truth of God's word.

Jesus' arms are not short they can reach you wherever you are, He sees you and Loves you, cast all your cares and burdens on Him, He cares for you much more than you care for yourself, allow yourself to be wrapped in the everlasting arms, there has never been a soul who He has let down, no not one. Its a relationship of trust and not leaning on understanding.

Don't always be battle conscious, be victory conscious, Jesus has already won the victory, you are not here on Earth to spend your whole life fighting for every little thing you need. Jesus didn't do all that He did just for you told be a victim in life, this is the time for victory the battle is already won, we are in the season of Joy and rejoicing.

Knowing who you are is so important, our identity is what defines us, it is the hallmark of the path we will walk out in Life. As a believer our greatest identity is who we are in Christ, God has made us partakers of the divine nature. Knowing this will cause us to live a life of victory and all round success. You cannot be defeated, you have God's nature in you.

The sweetest person you will ever come to know is the Holy Spirit, He is so kind and loving, He is indeed the great Teacher, He is Power of the Godhead. As a believer, you cannot be successful in life or in ministry except by the leading of the Holy Spirit. Jesus said to His disciples that it was expedient that He went away so that the Comforter, the Helper, the Blessed Holy Spirit. He brings us to sweet communion with God, He is our connection to God through all that Christ has done for us.

The Holy Spirit is the one who brings life into Christianity, without Him we are just like every other religion trying to contact a higher being using rituals and dogmas, our prayers become nothing more than empty mumbles into the air, hoping there is an end recipient who hears our cries. With the Holy Spirit we know for sure that we contact God, our worship is alive, our praise is exhilarating and our prayers are effective and powerful!

The Word of God is alive and powerful, yet so many people have the Word memorized but don't see the manifestation thereof. The truth is the Word manifests in the presence of the Holy Spirit, from the beginning of time the Holy Spirit was brooding over the water that was covered with darkness, and when God spoke things came to being. Before Jesus left He commissioned His disciples to go into all the world, but He told not to do so Until they were endued with Power from on high.

Don't lose your passion for Christ, keep your faith aglow, let the fire of God burn deep inside you, let your light shine for the world to see. This is only possible by the Holy Spirit, He is the fire of God, that makes a believers life fervent and effective. You cannot be an effective Christian by human will power, it is only by the Holy Spirit that one can keep the faith and stand in God! We are burning ones, set ablaze by the Holy Spirit!

Many believers go about asking God for more power, more ability, more wisdom, more anointing etc, but the truth is you already have all that you need. The Father's answer to all these requests was to give us the Holy Spirit, the issue then is not a lack of power or anointing, but rather it is a lack of knowledge of what we already possess. You have the Holy Spirit allow Him to lead and guide you, He'll make your life a wonder.

The hope of you getting it right is the person of the Holy Spirit, it is impossible to live the Christian life without Him. The human mind cannot be convinced enough that you are a children of God, our stance in Christ is solidified by the conviction of the Holy Spirit. This witness is not part of our mental faculty, it is truth that stems from our spirit. You are a bona-fide child of God by faith in Jesus Christ.

The seal that one has believed the Gospel is not necessarily a change in behavior, the coming of the Holy Spirit in one life is the seal, a behavioural change is a by-product of being sealed with the Holy Spirit. Our focus on life transformation should never be a change in deeds but rather the person of the Holy Spirit, He is the one who brings conviction and leads us in the ways of God.

There is no Earthly deed that can make one Holy, in modern Christianity many consider the avoidance of sin and immorality to be Holiness, but that is such a downplay on the fullness of our call to Holiness. Holiness is a state of being sanctified unto God and marked by His presence. The gold utensils used in the Temple were made of common gold, but once their were set apart for use in the Temple, they became holy. The Holy Spirit's presence in your life is what makes you Holy and set apart.

The Holy Spirit is a real person, He is a member of the Godhead, He is not a power that makes people fall down or speak in tongues, He is a person, He has personality, He is the greatest communicator, He speaks, He teaches, He comforts He feels what you feel and if you ask Him, He will get you out of any situation, He can teach you about any and every subject, get to know Him more.

The strength of a man's life is the strength of his knowledge, what you know is the reason why you are where you are in longevity, the difference in the salary payroll of a company is usually based on what people know, if you get knowledge you will rise to higher places. The lack of Knowledge is the downfall on many people, there is nothing noble about ignorance, get the required knowledge.
